text.en: Put dried spices in early; ground spices can be cooked in oil first and then go into the dish.
text.de: Getrocknete Gewürze früh zugeben; gemahlene Gewürze lassen sich zuerst in Öl garen und kommen dann ins Gericht.

why.en: Their flavour needs the cooking to develop, and the oil releases the aroma of ground spices.
why.de: Ihr Geschmack braucht das Garen, um sich zu entfalten, und das Öl löst das Aroma gemahlener Gewürze.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1 Flavors, section 1.3 Spices, Using Herbs and Spices
sources.sentence: Most dried spices need to be added early in order for their flavor to develop during the cooking.

sources.title: Fruits, Vegetables, and Farinaceous Products (Bienvenu and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1 Flavors, section 1.3 Spices, Using Herbs and Spices
sources.sentence: In some preparations, Indian curries for example, ground spices are first cooked in oil to release their aromas before being added to a dish.
